description: Composite group mixing a composition table with a temperature-time processing schematic. The table (captioned "Table 1. Chemical compositions (wt.%) of Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C-1V-5Ni steel ingot") has a header row "Element" listing Mn, Al, C, V, Ni, P, S, Fe, and one data row labelled "Concentration (wt.%)": Mn 30.45, Al 9.50, C 1.20, V 1.09, Ni 4.94, P 0.0040, S 0.0044, Fe Bal. The second panel is a schematic labelled (a) whose arrowed, unnumbered vertical and horizontal axes are labelled Temperature and Time: the path rises to a flat "1050 °C, 1 h Homogenization" plateau, continues into a zigzag annotated "Hot rolling reduction of 85%", descends to a low-temperature zigzag marked "Cold rolling reduction of 50%", rises to a "900 °C, 15 min Solution treatment" plateau, and ends with a downward arrow labelled "Water quenching". Partially cropped "(b)" and "(c)" labels at the right edge show this schematic belongs to a larger multi-panel figure. Together the panels state the alloy chemistry and the exact thermomechanical route applied to it; the schematic prints no numeric axis values.

subfigures.description: Two-row composition table: header row 'Element' with columns Mn, Al, C, V, Ni, P, S, Fe; data row 'Concentration (wt.%)' giving 30.45, 9.50, 1.20, 1.09, 4.94, 0.0040, 0.0044 and Bal. for Fe.

Schematic temperature-time profile with unnumbered arrowed axes: 1050 °C / 1 h Homogenization, Hot rolling reduction of 85% (zigzag), Cold rolling reduction of 50% (zigzag), 900 °C / 15 min Solution treatment, and a downward arrow for Water quenching.

observations.observation: Table 1 lists Mn = 30.45 wt.% and Al = 9.50 wt.% for the steel ingot.
Table 1 lists C = 1.20 wt.%, V = 1.09 wt.% and Ni = 4.94 wt.%.
Table 1 lists P = 0.0040 wt.% and S = 0.0044 wt.%, with Fe given as 'Bal.' (balance).
The table has the row label 'Concentration (wt.%)' and the column header 'Element', so all tabulated values are in wt.%.
The schematic panel (a) plots Temperature (vertical axis) against Time (horizontal axis); both axes are drawn as arrows and carry no numeric tick values.
Panel (a) shows a homogenization hold labelled '1050 °C, 1 h' before the hot-rolling step.
Panel (a) labels a zigzag segment, drawn while the temperature is still high, as 'Hot rolling reduction of 85%'.
Panel (a) labels a low-temperature zigzag as 'Cold rolling reduction of 50%'.
Panel (a) shows a final reheat plateau labelled '900 °C, 15 min Solution treatment' followed by a downward arrow labelled 'Water quenching'.
Partially cropped panel labels '(b)' and '(c)' are visible at the right edge of the supplied crop, indicating panel (a) is part of a larger multi-panel figure whose other panels are not shown here.
The caption states that Table 1 gives the chemical compositions (wt.%) of the Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C-1V-5Ni steel ingot.
The citing text states a 10 kg ingot of nominal composition Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C-1V-5Ni (wt.%) was prepared by induction melting under high-purity argon.
The citing text states Fe, Mn, Al, Ni and V were analyzed by inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES) and C by the combustion-infrared absorption method.

The citing text states plates 90 mm x 40 mm x 20 mm were homogenized at 1050 °C for 1 h, hot-rolled to 3 mm and water-quenched, then cold-rolled to ~1.5 mm (single-pass reduction <=5%, total 50%) and solution-treated at 900 °C for 15 min, as shown in Figure 1a.
